title: Endurance Technologies Ltd - 540153 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Endurance Q1 FY27 standalone total income rose 35.9% to ₹3,194.15 crores, with EBITDA margin at 11.2% after a commodity pass-through headwind.
summary.overview: Standalone total income grew 35.9% YoY to ₹3,194.15 crores, EBITDA rose 17.1% to ₹357.78 crores (11.2% margin) and PAT rose 17.4% to ₹194.62 crores. Management said commodity inflation (RMC at 68.4% of total income vs 64.8% a year ago) compressed margins; ex this pass-through, EBITDA margin would be 13.33%. Consolidated PAT grew 8% to ₹244.52 crores, with Maxwell turning PAT-positive for the first time. Management expects Q2 and Q3 margins to improve as raw material and conversion cost increases are settled with OEMs, and cited multiple SOPs and order wins across 2W, 4W castings, batteries and non-auto solar products.

segments.name: India auto (standalone)
segments.commentary: Q1 India order wins were ₹391.6 crores (₹365.4 crores replacement, ₹26.1 crores new), with ₹373 crores from 2W and ₹18.6 crores from 4W; ₹336 crores came from HMSI, including ₹219.6 crores of suspension facelift business at better margins.

segments.name: Europe (Stöferle/Endurance Overseas)
segments.commentary: Booked €13.9 million of orders in Q1, including a Mercedes hybrid transmission component (100% volume after a competitor's bankruptcy, SOP January 2027) and a Stellantis ICE program. Q1 EBITDA margin 18.2%.

segments.name: Maxwell (BMS/electronics)
segments.commentary: Total income ₹56.5 crores; ₹13 crores of new orders in Q1 took cumulative orders to ₹238 crores per annum (peak in Q2 FY28); RFQ pipeline above ₹300 crores.

segments.name: Aluminium castings (4W)
segments.commentary: 4W casting business about ₹180 crores in Q1 with 6% 4W share; AURIC Shendra cumulative bookings reached ₹513 crores per annum, SOP from September 2026; Hyundai/Kia order of ₹80 crores per annum started this month.

segments.name: Non-auto solar products
segments.commentary: Solar damper and actuator business won totals ₹345 crores (₹118 crores dampers, ₹227 crores actuators); Spanish client SOP started in August 2026.

guidance_outlook: Management expects all raw material increases to be recovered from OEMs in Q2, with aluminium alloy rates softening by ₹12-17/kg; Q2 and Q3 margins expected to be better than Q1, though no quantum given.
Gas, fuel and manpower increases expected to be settled with OEMs in Q2 or Q3.
India capex in FY27 expected similar to FY26 level of about ₹800 crores (FY26 vs ₹611 crores in FY25); mgmt said capex including Tier-2 vendors would be higher.
Brake capacity target of 9 million disc brake assemblies and 9.6 million brake discs per annum by Q1 FY28; ABS capacity addition reduced to 9 lakh units from 12 lakh.
Alloy wheel plants expected to be at full capacity by end FY27; Maxwell orders to peak in Q2 FY28; full impact of Stöferle integration expected from September 2027.
Maharashtra incentive raised to ₹858 crores from ₹600 crores, availed through state GST refund over about seven years.
capex_capacity: Chennai disc brake plant: phase one machinery shifting from Waluj; phase two due Q3 FY27; capacity 3 million disc brake assemblies and 4 million discs per annum; Royal Enfield SOP expected next month.

ABS capacity planned at 9 lakh units per annum added to existing 6.4 lakh; SOP for ABS and CBS hydraulic brake expansion expected September or early October 2026; Bajaj dual channel ABS 120,000 units SOP this quarter, second programme of 120,000 units in Q3 FY27.
Alloy wheels: Chakan about 3 million sets (fully used) and Bidkin 1.8 million sets (about 60% utilised); total 4.8 million wheel sets.

Suspension: monthly capacity to reach 100,000 inverted front forks and shocks by end FY27; Pantnagar SOP of 25,000 sets per month from Q4 FY27; Hero and Suzuki SOP in Q3 FY27 (about ₹120 crores per annum).

Battery packs: Mindewadi assembly line capacity of about 17,000-18,000 packs per month expected to be fully used by October 2026; 4W battery pack capex of ₹62 crores with SOP by Q4 FY27; new SMT line for ECUs and BMS starts next month; fifth aluminium forging press SOP next quarter.
